coverage.evidence: Settings > Bot > Shoutouts holds the Automatic shoutouts and Shoutout message cards (dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:55-60; dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/shoutouts/ShoutoutsView.vue:93-150). Suggestions sit in Home Quick actions (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/home/components/QuickActionsPanel.vue:359). Every dashboard send runs the shoutout action, which makes the Helix shoutout plus a chat announcement (server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/ModerationController.cs:1854-1910; server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Stream/ShoutoutSender.cs:138-184).

Suggestions: up to 10, from the last 30 days, empty when offline, leaving out the broadcaster, the bot, chatters already shouted out and dismissed chatters (server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Moderation/Services/IShoutoutSuggestionService.cs:23-34; server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Stream/ShoutoutSuggestions/ShoutoutSuggestionService.cs:37-49,128-145). Waits of 2 and 60 minutes and the queue (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Stream/PipelineActions/ShoutoutAction.cs:210-213,265-289). Automatic rules of 10, 5, 8 and 60 minutes (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Stream/AutoShoutout/AutoShoutoutScheduler.cs:41-44,294-321).

SendShoutoutAsync needs moderator:manage:shoutouts on the broadcaster connection and sends as the channel (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Transport/Helix/SubClients/TwitchChatApi.cs:72-103). A missing scope is reported as a Needs attention item titled 'Twitch permission missing: {scope}' (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Transport/Helix/TwitchTokenResolver.cs:319-349; server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Notifications/Sources/TwitchGrantGapSource.cs:148; dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:1130). Speech only when Speak is set (ShoutoutSender.cs:206).

Order: step template, per-target override, the target's own channel template, own template, built-in (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Stream/ShoutoutSender.cs:94-101). Use the default clears the field and saves at once (ShoutoutsView.vue:85-88); the server stores whitespace as null (ModerationController.cs:2134-2147). The per-streamer line is set and removed through shoutout-overrides (ModerationController.cs:2210-2260; dashboard/src/components/layout/profile/ProfileShoutoutLine.vue:49-123).

Inside the per-user wait, a chat or dashboard request (MessageId set, not a raid) announces with Speak true and SkipNative, at most once per 2 minutes (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Stream/PipelineActions/ShoutoutAction.cs:236-262; ModerationController.cs:1879). Queued results return 202, and the Home row still shows 'Shoutout sent.'; the page says a queued shoutout goes out later (ModerationController.cs:1900-1910; dashboard/src/api/people.ts:408-425).

reader_answers.evidence: The Settings > Bot > Shoutouts switch and Message with Save match ShoutoutsView.vue:51-60,120-147 and settingsNavigation.ts:55-60. Shoutout and Not now on Home match ShoutoutSuggestions.vue:108-123. The pipeline with a Shoutout step and user_id {args.1} matches ShoutoutAction.cs:96-103,179-182 and ChatMessageHandler.cs:1928. The Runs a pipeline command matches commands i18n en.json:119-126.

moderator:manage:shoutouts is required (TwitchChatApi.cs:72-85). TTS is needed only for speech (ShoutoutSender.cs:206-218). The defaults moderation:read and moderation:shoutout are at Mod level (10) and up: LeadModerator 20, Editor 30, Broadcaster 40 (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:51-54,241,277; settings/shoutouts/route.ts:21).

'Pipeline saved.' (pipelines i18n en.json:171), 'Shoutout message saved.' (shoutouts i18n en.json:6), 'Shoutout sent.' and the failure text (home i18n en.json:36-37), and the scope attention title (en.json:1130). The 2-minute wait queues (ShoutoutAction.cs:265-289); the 60-minute per-user wait gives an announcement only (ShoutoutAction.cs:236-262).

The per-user default is 60 minutes (ShoutoutAction.cs:210). A chat or dashboard request inside it skips the native call, speaks, sends no queued line and repeats at most every 2 minutes (ShoutoutAction.cs:236-262). Suggestions leave out chatters shouted out this stream (ShoutoutSuggestionService.cs:131,148-155).
